invariants.rationale: This invariant states precisely how result is computed in terms of parameters and object state.
If result is true, then index must be less than states.size - 1, reflecting the first part of the method's return condition.
If result is true, then the next text in the stack differs from currentText, as required by the second part of the guard.
If we do not allow redo, it's because either there is no further state or the next state's text matches the current text.
